answer: By the horizon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The whisper lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the meadow is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
